clues: This town is the capital of a province in Ecuador. It sits by a river that flows to the Amazon River.
The seasons here change just a bit through the year. Most days bring sun, then a short burst of hard rain.
This town was founded in 1899. It then grew to be the trade and culture heart of its land.
Back in 2006, this city was the fastest growing city in all of Ecuador. No place in the land grew so fast that year.
This town lies on the way from Baños to Tena. It sits on the way from Baños to Macas too.
